desc:
🍕 Chef Gigantino has locked the warehouse doors, and nobody leaves until the world's biggest pizza is gone. Play solo or bring up to 3 friends! 🔒

🖐️ You start with your bare hands. Eat until your stomach is full, run it off on a treadmill for Cash 💵, then buy a bigger tool: 🍴 Fork, 🌪️ Vacuum, 🔴 Laser, and finally a 🕳️ Black Hole that swallows everything around you as you walk. Cash pays better as the pizza shrinks, up to x4 near the end! 🔥

🍕 Three pizzas to beat, each one unlocking the next:
🍅 Margherita: 250,000 slices
🌶️ Pepperoni: 500,000 slices
🍍 Hawaiian: 1,000,000 slices

💎 Look out for rare gem slices worth up to x15!

🏆 Every pizza you finish pays Diamonds. Spend them in the piazza on permanent upgrades, or 🎰 spin for one of 7 classes, from Hungry Kid to the 1% Pizza Titan!
